title: Small yet Sophisticated
cardAlt: Renovated kitchen with white upper cabinets, black lower cabinets and granite counters
heroAlt: Renovated kitchen with white upper cabinets, black lower cabinets, granite counters and a curved range hood
paragraphs: Working within the existing footprint, this kitchen was reimagined to maximize every inch. Through a more intentional layout and the elimination of wasted space, a compact kitchen was transformed into a highly functional design that proves thoughtful planning can make even the smallest spaces work harder.

A compact kitchen, finished in creamy white upper cabinets and dark stained lower cabinets, granite countertops and a curved range hood as the focal point. The two-tone palette keeps the small footprint feeling clean and deliberate, while replacing the original white cabinets, coil range and farmhouse sink brought more modern functionality to the space.
